description: Add a cinematic animated aurora/gradient mesh background to the hero section using pure CSS (keyframed multi-color radial gradients that shift slowly), add an infinite horizontal marquee/ticker strip below the trust section with looping brand words, and add a testimonials/social-proof section with large editorial quotes
steps: In css/style.css, add a .hero-aurora class with multiple radial-gradient layers that animate position/scale via @keyframes (colors: cyan, coral, lime from the design system at very low opacity). This sits behind the video but above the base background. Use will-change: transform and composite-friendly properties.

In index.html, add a
inside .hero-bg, before the canvas element.

In css/style.css, add styles for a .marquee section: overflow hidden, .marquee-track uses @keyframes translateX loop, duplicate content for seamless infinite scroll. Typography: font-display, large (clamp 40px-80px), very light opacity (0.08-0.12), uppercase. Add a subtle gradient fade on edges.

In index.html, add a <section class='marquee' aria-hidden='true'> between the trust strip and the work section. Content: repeated words like 'DESIGN / BRANDING / WEB / IDENTITE / STRATEGIE / DAKAR / ACQUISITION' duplicated for seamless loop.

In css/style.css, add styles for .testimonials section: editorial layout with large opening quote marks (font-serif, 120px+), quote text in font-display at clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 42px), author name smaller. Cards should have a glassmorphism border and subtle gradient background.

In index.html, add a <section class='testimonials' id='testimonials'> between the clients strip and the services section. Include 3 testimonial quotes with author names and roles. Use realistic-sounding French quotes about working with AMEVIA.

In js/main.js, add initMarquee() function that pauses the marquee animation on hover (CSS animation-play-state toggled via class). Also add scroll-triggered reveal for testimonials. Call both in boot().
Ensure all new animations are guarded with prefersReduced check - marquee should be static, aurora should not animate, testimonials should be visible without motion.
acceptance_criteria: Hero section has a slowly animating multi-color aurora gradient visible behind/around the video
An infinite horizontal text marquee scrolls between trust strip and work section
A testimonials section with 3 quotes appears between clients and services
No JS syntax errors (node --check js/main.js passes)
verification: Visually confirm aurora, marquee, and testimonials sections exist in index.html
